_comment: Issue #1041 (physical rearguard for disengage-with-sacrifice). Two Infantry regiments clash at close range; once engaged, the team-0 unit is selected and Shift+Ctrl+Down triggers disengage-with-sacrifice. A real rearguard sub-unit spawns at the point of contact and keeps fighting while the main body steps back and away -- watch the rearguard hold the enemy in place (no top-down pursuit-speed multiplier; the enemy is physically blocked by real bodies) while the retreating survivors open distance behind it.
